title: logast vocabulary worksheet
description: Every MDC / [k=v] key the services use. Decide per key (term, same_as or local), then run `logast fleet <name> --vocabulary` again.

areas.description: Business areas: groups of packages whose terms apply only there.

packages.description: Yours to set: the packages this area covers, e.g. [com.example.billing].

terms.description: Rewritten on each run: the terms decided for this area.

known_in.description: Rewritten on each run: services whose logast.yaml names this area.

keys.description: One entry per key. Set exactly one of term, same_as or local on the keys you decide.

term.description: Decision: this key is a company-wide term with this name (e.g. order for orderId); the key is its name in logs.

same_as.description: Decision: the same value as this other key; apply renames this key to the other key's term.

local.description: Decision: only for its own service(s); not published.

owner.description: Optional, with term: who to ask about the term (a comment in company.yaml).

area.description: Optional, with term: publish the term under areas.<area> in company.yaml.

warning.description: Rewritten on each run: check this before deciding.

similar.description: Rewritten on each run: keys that look like the same value.

evidence.description: Rewritten on each run: where each service uses the key.
